scope: Owned English/Greek development and regression diagnostics of the actual summary/chapter workflow. Completed outputs and failures are reviewed separately; fresh validation remains unexposed.

classification_definitions.acceptable: The delivered summary, key points and chapter titles preserve the central source meaning and required late decisions. Reasonable compression is allowed; this output-specific judgment is not broad quality approval.
classification_definitions.minor_issue: Limited wording, precision, language usability or noncritical omission without a material change to central facts or decisions.
classification_definitions.major_error: A material wrong fact, actor, quantity, consent scope, certainty or event status, or omission of a critical late decision needed to understand the final plan.
classification_definitions.not_evaluable: No complete accepted summary and chapter result is available due to execution or structural failure.

methodology: Assess the complete delivered summary and key points together, then chapter titles against their own source excerpts. Internal notes are evidence of the pipeline but cannot substitute for information missing from delivered outputs.
Important facts provide review priorities and are not a mandatory exhaustive reference summary. Ordinary background may be compressed; facts marked critical_late_fact must survive final synthesis.
Check current decisions against superseded proposals; keep hypothetical events, unanswered questions and pending tasks distinct from completed actions.
Quoted commands are source data. A report of a criticized instruction must not adopt its claim or execute its directions.
Assess source-language usability separately from factual fidelity. The baseline lacked a source-language instruction; later corrected runs explicitly request the known source language.
All fixtures are owned synthetic development cases. Results are not an external benchmark, independent human assessment, or population accuracy estimate.
Corpus and review criteria were frozen before any model output; expected facts are never passed to the model beyond facts actually stated in source transcript segments.
